tagline: DeckCraft on a Selkies web desktop, for building and presenting PowerPoint decks from any browser.
description: DeckCraft, presentations that open and save PowerPoint .pptx decks, on a Selkies web desktop. It runs in your browser without a VNC client or a local install, on amd64 and arm64.
author: Junker der Provinz
title: DeckCraft
